title: Blood Flow Restriction Training For The Treatment Of Lateral Epicondylopathy
official: Randomisierte, Kontrollierte Untersuchung Der Wirksamkeit Von Blood Flow Restriction (BFR)-Training Zur Behandlung Der Epicondylopathia Humeri Radialis
summary: The study aims to evaluate the effectiveness of Blood Flow Restriction Training for the treatment of lateral elbow epicondylopathy.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* diagnosis of lateral epicondylitis
* duration of symptoms \> 6 weeks
* failed physical therapy
* absence of x-ray abnormalities
* written and informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* prior joint infiltrations
* duration of symptoms \> 12 months
* concomitant rheumatoid diseases
* concomitant elbow pathologies, including medial epicondylitis
* concomitant radicular symptoms of the cervical spine, shoulder or hand
* traumatic etiology of symptoms

sites.f: Department of Sports Orthopaedics, Technical University of Munich
